title: Cookie Policy (EU)
content:
Cookie Policy

Last updated: 27 August 2026

1. Introduction

This Cookie Policy explains how Maison Debrah / Debrah International (“Maison Debrah”, “we”, “us” or “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit maisondebrah.com (the “Website”).

This policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data.

By using the Website, you may encounter cookies and similar technologies that are necessary for the Website to function, as well as optional cookies that help us understand how visitors use the Website or support our marketing activities.

Where required by law, we will ask for your consent before placing non-essential cookies on your device.

2. What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer, tablet, mobile phone or other device when you visit a website.

Cookies allow a website to recognise your device and remember certain information about your visit.

Cookies can be used for a number of purposes, including:

  • Making websites function correctly
  • Remembering preferences
  • Improving website performance
  • Understanding how visitors use a website
  • Measuring the effectiveness of marketing
  • Providing relevant advertising and marketing services

Cookies may be session cookies, which are deleted when you close your browser, or persistent cookies, which remain on your device for a specified period or until you delete them.

3. How we use cookies

Maison Debrah uses cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes:

3.1 Strictly necessary cookies

These cookies are required for the Website to function properly.

They may be used to:

  • Maintain essential website functionality
  • Remember necessary website settings
  • Support account and login functionality
  • Support shopping and enquiry functionality
  • Maintain security
  • Enable forms and other essential features
  • Remember cookie consent preferences

These cookies cannot normally be disabled through our cookie consent tool because the Website may not function correctly without them.

3.2 Functional cookies

Functional cookies allow the Website to remember choices you make and provide enhanced functionality.

For example, they may be used to remember:

  • Website preferences
  • Login or account-related information
  • Certain functionality selected during your visit

Where these cookies are not strictly necessary, they will only be used where permitted by applicable law and, where required, with your consent.

3.3 Analytics cookies

We may use analytics technologies, including Google Analytics 4, to understand how visitors use our Website.

Analytics information may include:

  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on pages
  • How visitors navigate through the Website
  • Referring websites
  • Browser and device information
  • Approximate geographic information
  • Website interactions

We use this information to understand website performance and improve the Website and customer experience.

Analytics cookies are only used where you have provided the appropriate consent, where required by applicable law. Our Privacy Policy identifies Google Analytics 4 as an analytics service used by Maison Debrah.

3.4 Marketing cookies

We may use marketing and advertising technologies, including Meta Pixel, to understand the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and, where applicable, help us measure interactions with our advertising.

Marketing technologies may collect information about:

  • Pages visited
  • Website interactions
  • Referring websites
  • Browser and device information
  • Advertising interactions

Marketing cookies are only placed where the appropriate consent has been provided, where required by applicable law.

Our Privacy Policy currently identifies Meta Pixel as a marketing technology used by Maison Debrah.

3.5 Email and newsletter technologies

Where you subscribe to our newsletter or other marketing communications, we may use an email marketing provider to manage subscriptions and communications.

These services may use cookies or similar tracking technologies to measure interactions with emails, such as whether an email has been opened or a link has been clicked.

Marketing communications are only sent where we have an appropriate lawful basis, including consent where required.

Our Privacy Policy currently identifies Mailchimp / an email provider as a service used for newsletter and email communications.

4. Third-party cookies

Some cookies may be placed by third-party services that we use to operate, analyse or improve the Website.

These may include services such as:

  • Google Analytics
  • Meta
  • Email marketing providers
  • Website security and performance services
  • Embedded third-party content or services

Third-party providers may process information in accordance with their own privacy and cookie policies.

Where third-party cookies are not strictly necessary, we will seek your consent before activating them where required by applicable law.

5. Your cookie choices

When you first visit the Website, you may be presented with a cookie consent banner.

Depending on the cookies being used, you may be able to:

  • Accept all cookies
  • Reject non-essential cookies
  • Select which categories of cookies you consent to
  • Change your preferences at a later date

You can change or withdraw your cookie consent at any time by accessing the cookie settings available on the Website.

Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality or performance of parts of the Website.

6. How to manage cookies through your browser

You can also control or delete cookies through your browser settings.

Most browsers allow you to:

  • View cookies stored on your device
  • Delete existing cookies
  • Block cookies
  • Block third-party cookies
  • Receive a notification before cookies are stored

Please refer to your browser’s help documentation for information on how to manage cookies.

Blocking all cookies may affect your ability to use some features of the Website.

7. How long cookies remain on your device

Cookies may remain on your device for different periods depending on their purpose.

Some cookies are deleted when you close your browser, while others may remain for a longer period.

The exact cookies and their respective durations may change as we update or improve the Website.

Our cookie consent management system may also retain a record of your consent preferences for the period necessary to demonstrate compliance with applicable data protection requirements.

8. Changes to this Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect:

  • Changes to the cookies and technologies used on the Website
  • Changes to our services
  • Changes to applicable laws or regulations
  • Changes to our privacy and compliance practices

When we make changes, we will update the “Last updated” date at the top of this policy.

We recommend checking this page periodically for the latest information.

9. Contact us

If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy or how we use cookies, please contact us.

Maison Debrah / Debrah International
GUANGZHOU DEBRAH TRADING CO., LTD
No. 9, Fengxiang South Road
Baiyun District
Guangzhou, China

Email: contact@maisondebrah.com
Website: maisondebrah.com

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

1. Introduction

Maison Debrah (“we”, “us”, “our”) is committed to protecting your personal data and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information about you when you visit maisondebrah.com (the “Website”) or contact us.

Please read this policy carefully. If you have questions, contact us at the details below.

2. Who We Are

Maison Debrah is a luxury interior brand operating globally. For the purposes of GDPR and EU data protection law, we are the data controller of personal data collected through this Website.

Company name Maison Debrah / Debrah International
Legal form GUANGZHOU DEBRAH TRADING CO., LTD
Registered address No. 9, Fengxiang South Road, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, China
Country of registration China
Registration number 91440111MA59BBFMXL
Website maisondebrah.com
Contact email contact@maisondebrah.com
Operating territory Global — serving clients and partners worldwide

3. What Data We Collect

We may collect the following categories of personal data:

3.1 Data you provide directly

  • Name, email address, phone number – when you fill in a contact form, newsletter signup, or trade registration form
  • Company name, business type, country – when you register as a trade partner or franchise enquirer
  • Project details, budget range, timeline – when you submit a project enquiry
  • Login credentials – if you create a trade account

3.2 Data collected automatically

  • IP address and browser type – collected by our server and analytics tools
  • Pages visited, time on site, referring URL – collected via Google Analytics 4
  • Cookie and tracking data – see our Cookie Policy (Section 5)

3.3 Data we do NOT collect

  • We do not collect payment card data. This Website does not process online payments.
  • We do not collect sensitive personal data (health, ethnicity, religion, etc.)

4. How We Use Your Data

We use your personal data for the following purposes. The legal basis under GDPR is stated for each:

Purpose Data used Legal basis (GDPR)
Contact form enquiries Name, email, message Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f))
Newsletter & marketing emails Email address, preferences Consent (Art. 6(1)(a))
Analytics & site improvement IP, pages visited, cookies Consent (Art. 6(1)(a))
Trade account registration Name, company, login credentials Contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
Franchise / trade enquiries Name, email, company info Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f))
Legal obligations As required Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))

5. Cookies

Our Website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us understand how you use our site. Our full Cookie Policy is available as a separate page at: maisondebrah.com/cookie-policy

Types of cookies we use:

  • Essential cookies – required for the Website to function. Cannot be disabled.
  • Analytics cookies – Google Analytics 4, to understand visitor behaviour. Only set with your consent.
  • Marketing cookies – Meta Pixel (Facebook), to track campaign performance. Only set with your consent.
  • Functional cookies – remember your preferences and login state.

When you first visit our Website, a cookie consent banner will appear allowing you to accept, reject, or manage your preferences. You can change your preferences at any time. Disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.

6. Who We Share Your Data With

We do not sell your personal data. We work with the following categories of third-party service providers (data processors), each bound by a data processing agreement:

Processor Purpose Location
Hosting provider (WordPress/WooCommerce) Website hosting and CMS EU / [TO CONFIRM]
Google Analytics 4 Website analytics and traffic measurement USA (SCCs apply)
Meta Pixel (Facebook) Marketing campaign tracking (Pixel ID: 1468753941587054) USA (SCCs apply)
Mailchimp / Email provider Newsletter and email communications USA (SCCs apply)
Professional advisors Legal, financial, and compliance advice Confidential basis
Regulatory authorities Where required by law As applicable

Where we transfer personal data outside the European Economic Area (EEA) — including to the United States for services such as Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, and Mailchimp — we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place. These safeguards include:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, and/or
  • EU adequacy decisions where the receiving country has been deemed to provide an adequate level of data protection.

You may request details of the specific safeguards in place by contacting us at contact@maisondebrah.com.

7. Data Retention

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this policy, or as required by law:

  • Contact form and enquiry data – retained for up to 2 years
  • Trade account data – retained for the duration of your account, plus 2 years
  • Newsletter subscriber data – retained until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics data – Google Analytics 4 default retention period (up to 14 months)
  • Cookie consent records – retained for the duration required to demonstrate compliance

8. Your Rights (GDPR)

If you are based in the European Union, European Economic Area, or United Kingdom, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • Right of access – request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
  • Right to rectification – ask us to correct inaccurate data
  • Right to erasure – ask us to delete your data in certain circumstances
  • Right to restrict processing – ask us to limit how we use your data
  • Right to data portability – request your data in a machine-readable format
  • Right to object – object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing
  • Right to withdraw consent – where processing is based on consent, withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at: contact@maisondebrah.com. We will respond within 30 days.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority. To find your authority, visit: https://edpb.europa.eu/about-edpb/about-edpb/members_en

9. Security & Data Breach Procedure

We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration, or destruction. Our Website uses SSL encryption (HTTPS).

In the event of a personal data breach, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, where required under GDPR. Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will also notify you directly without undue delay.

However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Minors

This Website is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If you are under 16, please do not use this Website or submit any personal data. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a person under 16 without appropriate consent, we will delete it promptly.

11. Third-Party Links

Our Website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to read their privacy policies.

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

13. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

Maison Debrah / Debrah International
Email: contact@maisondebrah.com
Website: maisondebrah.com

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
Terms & Conditions

1. Introduction

These Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) govern your use of the Maison Debrah website at maisondebrah.com (“Website”). By accessing or using our Website, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our Website.

Maison Debrah reserves the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the Website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

2. About Us

Maison Debrah is a luxury interior brand. We curate and supply furniture, lighting, and décor for residential, hospitality, and commercial environments. This Website is a B2B platform for product discovery, trade registration, and enquiry submission. It does not facilitate direct online sales.

Contact: contact@maisondebrah.com · Website: maisondebrah.com

3. Use of the Website

3.1 Permitted use

You may use this Website for lawful purposes only and in accordance with these Terms. You agree not to:

  • Use the Website in any way that is unlawful, harmful, or fraudulent
  • Copy, reproduce, or distribute content from the Website without our written permission
  • Attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the Website or its systems
  • Use automated tools (bots, scrapers) to extract data from the Website
  • Impersonate any person or misrepresent your affiliation with any entity

3.2 Age restriction

This Website is intended for use by individuals aged 16 and over. By using this Website, you confirm that you meet this requirement.

3.3 Account registration

Certain features of our Website, including trade pricing and the quote request function, require registration. When registering you agree to:

  • Provide accurate and complete information
  • Keep your login credentials confidential
  • Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use of your account

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts at our discretion, including where we suspect misuse or where registration criteria are not met.

4. Products and Pricing

4.1 Product information

We make every effort to display product information, dimensions, and images accurately. However, we do not guarantee that descriptions are completely accurate, current, or error-free. Product colours may vary depending on your screen settings.

4.2 Pricing

All pricing is confirmed at the time of quotation, available upon login and approval. This Website does not process payments. Pricing, invoicing, and payment terms are managed directly between Maison Debrah and the client.

4.3 Availability

Product availability is subject to change. We reserve the right to discontinue any product at any time without notice.

5. Quote Requests and Orders

This Website is a B2B platform. It does not facilitate direct online purchases. Submitting a quote request or adding items to your quote list does not constitute a binding order or contract.

A contract is only formed when we confirm your order in writing and you accept the quotation terms provided. We reserve the right to decline any order or enquiry without providing a reason.

6. Intellectual Property

All content on this Website — including text, images, graphics, logos, product photography, and design — is the property of Maison Debrah or our content licensors, and is protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, or use our content without our prior written consent. Requests for use of our imagery or content should be directed to our team.

7. Trade Programme

Our trade programme is open to qualified professionals including interior designers, architects, retailers, and hospitality buyers. Approval is at our sole discretion.

Trade account holders agree to:

  • Use trade pricing exclusively for professional client projects
  • Not resell products purchased at trade pricing to the general public at trade rates
  • Maintain the confidentiality of trade pricing information

We reserve the right to revoke trade access at any time if these conditions are not met.

8. Disclaimer of Warranties

The Website and its content are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. Maison Debrah makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding:

  • The accuracy, completeness, or reliability of Website content
  • The uninterrupted or error-free operation of the Website

title: The Collection
content:
Maison Debrah
 Mastering the Art of Living

Maison Debrah
 Mastering the Art of Living

The Collection

The Collection

Mastering the Art of Living

Mastering the Art of Living

The Maison Debrah Collection embodies refined living through timeless design and impeccable craftsmanship. Each piece is created with purpose — balancing form, texture, and emotion to elevate every interior.

Every design is a meeting point of heritage and modernity. Crafted for those who value understated luxury and enduring beauty. Through this philosophy, Maison Debrah transforms furniture into a curated experience where elegance and functionality exist in perfect harmony.

Where design becomes experience

At Maison Debrah, design transcends decoration. It is the language through which spaces come alive. Each collection is curated to evoke atmosphere, connection, and quiet sophistication. Transforming rooms into expressions of identity and emotion.

Our collections are trusted by international designers and prestigious hospitality brands such as Hilton, InterContinental, and Pan Pacific Hotels, gracing interiors from Milan to Dubai, from Paris to Singapore.

Crafted for a lifetime

Behind every design lies nearly three decades of craftsmanship excellence. Our team of artisans and designers combine heritage techniques with contemporary innovation, mastering materials such as wood, metal, glass, and stone entirely in-house. The result: enduring quality and timeless appeal.

Furniture

Maison Debrah furniture celebrates form and proportion in their purest expression.
From sculptural lounge pieces to tailored dining settings, each design is built to define a room not just fill it.

Materials are selected with care, finishes are refined by hand, and details are executed with precision. Beause of that our furniture collections bring together comfort, structure, and style in perfect balance. Whether for private residences, boutique hotels, or executive spaces, Maison Debrah delivers pieces that embody quiet confidence, lasting comfort, and architectural beauty. Every chair, table, and console tells a story of intention. A statement of artistry designed to endure. Designed for comfort, created for distinction.

Explore the furtniture collection ➔

Lighting

At Maison Debrah, lighting is designed not only to illuminate but to inspire.
Our luminaires are sculptural compositions. Balancing geometry, material, and mood to create depth and atmosphere.
From dramatic chandeliers and refined wall sconces to minimalist floor lamps. Each piece is engineered to transform both residential and hospitality interiors.

Every design combines warm radiance with structural clarity, celebrating the interplay between light and shadow.

Maison Debrah lighting is more than function. It’s the emotional signature of every room. Illumination as an art form. Light is the soul of a space.

See the lightning collection ➔

Décor

Décor is where the Maison Debrah philosophy meets its most intimate form.
Each accessory, mirror, textile, and accent object is designed to complete the story of a space. Refined yet expressive, functional yet poetic.

Our décor line reflects the beauty of material harmony: glass meets brass, linen softens marble, texture embraces silence. These subtle layers add warmth and rhythm, turning interiors into living works of art. From statement mirrors to sculpted accessories, every detail invites touch, reflection, and connection.

In Maison Debrah décor, emotion resides in the smallest gesture. It’s the finishing touch of effortless sophistication.

Discover our décor items ➔

Explore the world of Maison Debrah

Step into a curated world where luxury is felt, not shown.
Whether furnishing a private residence, boutique hotel, or retail flagship, Maison Debrah delivers a complete interior experience. Crafted with intention, inspired by culture, and made to last.

About Maison Debrah

About Maison Debrah

Maison Debrah – Mastering the Art of Living

Maison Debrah –
Mastering the Art of Living

Since 1996, Maison Debrah has shaped a world where craftsmanship, culture, and emotion come together in a modern expression of luxury living. What began as a small atelier in Guangzhou has grown into one of the few global manufacturers capable of mastering wood, metal, glass, and stone entirely in-house.

Today, the company operates within a 130,000 m² industrial park with 13 specialized divisions and a 750m² showroom that brings innovation and design together under one roof.

Rooted in nearly three decades of expertise, Maison Debrah represents the next chapter of Debrah International. A chapter defined by refinement, continuity, and a confident global design perspective.

A new era of luxury living

Maison Debrah speaks to those who seek more than aesthetics alone.
For homeowners, designers, and hoteliers who value atmosphere, emotion, and quiet sophistication, we create interiors that feel intentional and enduring.

Our collections are shaped by nearly three decades of craftsmanship, design vision, and material refinement. Every piece is considered, curated, and crafted to bring harmony, presence, and timeless character to the spaces it inhabits.

These are designs that define a room. Not merely appear in it.

Full-scope interior excellence

Maison Debrah offers a seamless, design-led experience that brings every element of interior living together:

  • Turnkey franchise concepts for the luxury interiors market
  • Shop-in-shop partnerships for premium retailers

  • Complete interior solutions for residential, commercial, and hospitality environments

Our reliability, scale, and production precision make us a trusted partner for distinguished names including Hilton, InterContinental, and Pan Pacific Hotels.

Design beyond decoration

For us, design is a language – a way for vision to find its physical voice. Every creation begins with one question: how should this space feel?

Guided by proportion, posture, material, and texture, our international design team shapes pieces with depth, intention, and emotional clarity. This vision has contributed to landmark interiors across Paris, Singapore, Milan, Dubai, and beyond.

Our philosophy is quiet yet assured: True luxury is not a statement. It is a feeling that lingers.

The Maison Debrah aesthetic: refined, bold & balanced

Maison Debrah represents modern heritage. Honoring craftsmanship while shaping the future of global design. Our work balances harmony, experience, and sophistication, transforming interiors into places where people connect, unwind, and feel at home.
We design with purpose. We build with precision. We create with cultural awareness.

A world to experience

Our 750 m2 showroom is more than a presentation, it is a curated environment where materials, light, and architecture converse in quiet elegance. At its heart lies Le Grand Salon, a bold and refined space that captures the essence of Maison Debrah’s identity.
Here, design becomes theatre:

  • Luxury furniture & full-home concepts
  • Complete hospitality & residential solutions
  • Franchise and retail partnerships
  • In-house mastery of materials
  • Nearly 30 years of global trust
  • A signature aesthetic shaped by three design cultures
  • A brand devoted to harmony, precision, and timeless relevance

Our reliability, scale, and production precision make us a trusted partner for distinguished names including Hilton, InterContinental, and Pan Pacific Hotels.

through craftsmanship, intention, and the art of living.
